record.title: Senior Release Engineer
record.justification: record (rule): not relevant - 1 of 6 resume.key_skills matched in posting.title/posting.content (need >=2): "Python" in posting.content: "automation using scripting languages such as Python to reduce manual release activities and"

judgment.justification: posting.content lists release engineering responsibilities such as "Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications" and "Define and implement CI/CD patterns for platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora, and other Business Systems." Its AI references only require using AI tools as a productivity aid, not building, integrating, or operating AI systems: "Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude or similar tools every day to accelerate pipeline development, scripting, test creation, troubleshooting, documentation" and "Mandatory hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools such as Claude or comparable enterprise-approved tools as part of day-to-day DevOps and release engineering work." No duty involves training or fine-tuning models, RAG pipelines, building AI agents, or developing LLM applications. The company statement "we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier" is general and does not count.
